policy.character_stills: retain exact in-character online stills with source-page provenance; copyright status is labeled, not treated as an automatic veto
policy.performer_portraits: prefer free or permissioned portraits; allow honestly labeled sourced portraits when the archive policy permits
policy.manual_captures: fallback only; require production, episode or film, timestamp or frame context, capture date, and source ownership metadata
policy.accuracy: never fill a facet unless the exact expected subject is visible
